name: r6-mut-once-blob-uuid
description: Mutation triage (inventory pass, valve-once/due-rows and grace-cutoff rows; blob-text on valve_schedules.schedule_uuid): ONCE schedules whose schedule_uuid is stored as a BLOB. node-sqlite3 reads it as a Buffer and binds it back as a BLOB, so the intent row, its join to the schedule, the claim, the FIRED or SKIPPED update and the event payload ({"type":"Buffer",...}) all follow the BLOB: E1 (30 minutes late) is skipped, E2 (due) is opened. Go read the uuid as text and wrote a TEXT intent that joins no schedule, so it left E1 and E2 PENDING with a stray PENDING intent each. E3 (TEXT uuid) is the control.

steps.sql: INSERT INTO devices(deveui,name,type_id,user_id,irrigation_zone_id,current_state,target_state,created_at,updated_at,claimed_at) VALUES ('A8404100000000E1','Late blob','STREGA_VALVE',1,1,'CLOSED','CLOSED','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z'),('A8404100000000E2','Due blob','STREGA_VALVE',1,1,'CLOSED','CLOSED','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z'),('A8404100000000E3','Due text','STREGA_VALVE',1,1,'CLOSED','CLOSED','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z');INSERT INTO valve_schedules(schedule_uuid,device_eui,kind,fire_at,duration_minutes,timezone,enabled,once_state) VALUES (CAST('ceaa2200-0000-4000-8000-0000000000e1' AS BLOB),'A8404100000000E1','ONCE',strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-30 minutes'),7,'UTC',1,'PENDING');INSERT INTO valve_schedules(schedule_uuid,device_eui,kind,fire_at,duration_minutes,timezone,enabled,once_state) VALUES (CAST('ceaa2200-0000-4000-8000-0000000000e2' AS BLOB),'A8404100000000E2','ONCE',strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-1 minutes'),8,'UTC',1,'PENDING');INSERT INTO valve_schedules(schedule_uuid,device_eui,kind,fire_at,duration_minutes,timezone,enabled,once_state) VALUES ('ceaa2200-0000-4000-8000-0000000000e3','A8404100000000E3','ONCE',strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-1 minutes'),9,'UTC',1,'PENDING');
